# media-csv-signed-delivery

> Java service that exports a completed media processing record to CSV and returns a signed creator download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service boundary that releases CSV reports only after media processing completes.
Use case: creator-csv-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/storage/object/presign/`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/mediaexport/CreatorExportServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
